title: Harry Reid's plan for a billion-dollar AAWSAP

tellings.quote: Harry Reid had an intention on turning into a turning it into an Manhattan project. uh he was intend this was like just to get it started and then the subsequent fiscal years that would follow. He was intending this to go like maybe a decade with worth a billion dollars maybe $2 billion worth of programmatics.

plain: Senator Harry Reid of Nevada meant a Pentagon UFO study, begun in 2008 and known as AAWSAP, to grow into something like a new Manhattan Project, according to the physicist Eric W. Davis, who says he worked on it. Davis tells Michels the first funding was 'just to get it started.' Reid's plan, he says, was for the work to run for maybe a decade in later budget years and cost a billion dollars, 'maybe $2 billion.' If so, the effort was meant to be far bigger than the small study the public later heard about.
